answer: Ephemeral challenge binding. Each agent identity must answer a fresh, randomly seeded challenge whose nonce is derived from the prior block's hash; a valid response embeds a pearl of the agent's private state into a juniper-salted commitment. Correct answers form a spiral: each depends on the last, so precomputation fails. An attacker cloning identities must solve every challenge live, paying a distinct compute-and-latency cost per identity per round, making mass forgery linear in real resources.
